title: GoOrganicAfrica readiness batch 07 - Guinea and Guinea-Bissau administrative geography
scope: Current first-level regional lookup verification only. No country is certified calculator-ready.

countries.name: Guinea

administrative_geography.note: The government presentation predates the creation of Beyla and Siguiri. Their creation is confirmed by the August 2026 decree; confirm the implementing instrument and prefecture boundary assignments before regional crop mapping.

calculator_readiness.crop_area_production_yield: regional crop tables and revised prefecture crosswalk pending
calculator_readiness.farmgate_prices: dated regional farmgate prices and units pending
calculator_readiness.input_costs: seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs pending
calculator_readiness.currency: GNF; confirm price denomination and any redenomination or conversion treatment in source tables
calculator_readiness.tests: region/prefecture/crop mapping and localization tests pending

safeguards: Do not use pre-August 2026 region boundaries as if they were current.
Do not infer prefecture-to-new-region assignments without the implementing instrument.
Do not activate until crop data, prices, costs, budgets and tests are validated.

countries.name: Guinea-Bissau

administrative_geography.special_unit_note: The Autonomous Sector of Bissau is a separate first-order unit, not one of the eight regions, and is excluded from this region-only list.

calculator_readiness.crop_area_production_yield: regional crop data and survey extraction pending
calculator_readiness.farmgate_prices: dated regional farmgate prices and units pending
calculator_readiness.input_costs: seed, fertilizer, crop protection, irrigation, labour and machinery costs pending
calculator_readiness.currency: XOF; confirm local market price units and source dates
calculator_readiness.tests: regional crop calculation and localization tests pending

safeguards: Do not include the Autonomous Sector of Bissau as a region.
Do not treat historical rice series as current validated yields without source and unit checks.
Do not activate until crop data, prices, costs, budgets and tests are validated.

summary: Two additional regional lookup lists have been added. Guinea's two newly created regions are explicitly flagged for implementation crosswalk verification; Guinea-Bissau's autonomous capital sector is kept separate from the eight regions.
